description.html: Arcadia D3+ Desert Compact 12% is a full-spectrum compact fluorescent bulb with 12% UVB and 30% UVA. It has a built-in electronic ballast, so it screws straight into a standard E27 socket. According to the manufacturer, the 23 W model gives 416 lumens, a 8200 K colour temperature and a CRI above 90, is flicker free and has UVC-blocking glass.

UVB lets reptiles make vitamin D3 in their skin, which they need to use calcium. Arcadia says compact lamps are especially useful for young and smaller animals, and this bulb is intended for desert species that need strong UVB, especially young and smaller animals in smaller terrariums.

Fit the bulb in a socket above the basking spot, ideally in a fixture with a reflector. The manufacturer gives a safe recommended distance of 20 cm from the lamp to the reptile and advises against looking directly at the light source. The manufacturer states that the bulb provides UVB for 12 months, after which it should be replaced even though it still lights up.
For larger terrariums, a UVB tube that covers a bigger area is the better choice. Find sockets, tubes and other equipment in our equipment range.
